context: CI workflow with test and lint jobs. A teammate added npm caching and made lint depend on test.
explanation: Adding `needs: test` makes the lint job wait for the entire test suite to finish before starting. Lint and test are independent checks — running them in parallel gives faster feedback. The rest of the changes (npm caching, simplified eslint command) are fine, but serializing independent jobs unnecessarily slows the pipeline. Fix: remove the `needs: test` line so both jobs run concurrently.
